scope: Read-only XRAM_READ 0x31 capability probe on local WB2A / VDensHO1 / 20C2.

source.note: All 12 Vitosoft XRAM_READ events are GWG-family definitions, collapse to six address/length shapes, and use no PrefixRead.

interpretation: All six source-derived XRAM request shapes were rejected as VS2 Error Messages; no XRAM data was returned.
0x31 responses echo function 0x31 and consistently return one-byte error payload 05.
Matching 0x01 requests also fail at these cross-profile addresses, but with payload 01.
No source-backed meaning for inner error payload 01 or 05 has been recovered.
Because source XRAM definitions use no PrefixRead, omitted prefix data does not explain this rejection.
The result closes these GWG XRAM shapes for local VDensHO1. It does not prove every possible 0x31 address is unsupported, but there is no source-derived local success target.
next_step: Reconstruct an exact prefixed KMBUS_EEPROM_READ 0x43 request from Vitosoft metadata.
